hint.text:
For example:
I have a cousin whose wife is a famous politician.
→ whose = relative pronoun

atoms.b: A relative pronoun introduces a relative clause that gives more information about a ((++noun verb)) that has been mentioned before.
Relative pronouns include: who, whom, whose, that and ((++which witch)).

instruction.text: Fill in the gap with the correct relative pronoun.

atoms.b: This is Rebecca, ((++whose who)) brother is in my class.
India, ((++which whom)) is a country in South Asia, has the world’s largest population.
Emmeline Pankhurst ((++who whom)) was born in 1858, was an important part of women gaining the right to vote.
My aunt, from ((++whom whose)) I received a late birthday gift, lives in Italy.
I wish I had a robot ((++that whose)) could do my chores.
Maybe Sam, ((++who which)) is good at maths, could help me with the homework.
Niamh is the girl with ((++whom whose)) I went swimming.
Have you been to the new restaurant ((++that who)) serves vegan breakfast?
This is the singer ((++whose whom)) concert I went to last week.
